purchase.title: Record a customer purchase
purchase.summary: Payment happens outside Catera; recording it adds quota.
purchase.steps:
Open Customers and select the customer account.
Choose Record purchase, the purchased package, its start date, and an optional external reference.
Review the customer and package terms before confirming.
purchase.note: Validity and delivery count are saved with the purchase. Later package edits do not change previous purchases.

schedule.title: Create or revise a schedule
schedule.summary: Quota is reserved for the selected dates, weekdays and delivery slots.
schedule.steps:
Open the customer and choose Create schedule, or revise an existing pattern.
Choose a valid date range, delivery weekdays and delivery slots.
Review all dates and quota allocation. Confirm only when every delivery is funded.
schedule.note: Future-starting packages can fund dates within their validity. Generating a schedule does not recreate skipped deliveries.

production.title: Prepare production
production.summary: A complete frozen production version is required before a delivery is ready.
production.steps:
Select the working date and open Production.
Check meals, portion counts and source deliveries. Resolve missing menus/defaults.
After the change deadline, review the latest frozen version. Print or download CSV when needed.
production.note: Permitted late edits require a reason and create a revision. Review the latest revision before marking deliveries ready.

fulfillment.title: Fulfill deliveries
fulfillment.summary: Ready → In transit → Received follows the delivery’s real state.
fulfillment.steps:
Open Delivery for the working date. Select deliveries to mark ready or dispatch together.
Review the list, status changes and excluded deliveries. Confirm eligible deliveries only.
Confirm receipt individually after the customer receives the delivery. Record a failure if delivery did not succeed.
fulfillment.note: One quota is used on receipt. Failure keeps the reservation; retry uses the same reservation. Skipping releases it. An owner’s receipt reversal requires a reason.

quota.title: Understand quota
quota.summary: Remaining, Reserved and Available describe different things.
quota.steps:
Remaining is the package balance; reserved deliveries are still included.
Reserved is quota already held for active deliveries.
Available excludes reservations and packages currently outside their validity.
quota.note: One quota is used when a delivery is confirmed received. For future dates, check each package’s validity; today’s total does not guarantee every future date is funded.

menu.title: Choose a delivery meal
menu.summary: Choose a meal for a particular delivery before its change deadline.
menu.steps:
Open Schedule and select an editable delivery date.
Choose a meal, compare descriptions and select one available option.
Review the delivery and chosen meal before confirming.
menu.note: The choice affects only that delivery. At cutoff, a missing choice uses the published default when available. The operator must resolve a missing default.

cutoff.title: Check change deadlines
cutoff.summary: The delivery’s displayed date and timezone determine whether edits are open.
cutoff.steps:
Open the delivery and read its displayed change deadline.
Before it, meal, address, reschedule and skip changes follow delivery eligibility.
After it, customer edits are closed. Operators must record a reason for permitted late changes.
cutoff.note: The target date’s cutoff also applies when rescheduling. Changes do not extend package validity.

address.title: Change the right address
address.summary: The profile and existing scheduled deliveries keep separate addresses.
address.steps:
For future bookings, edit the profile address; operators use the customer account.
For an existing delivery, open that delivery and choose Edit address before cutoff.
Review the address and target delivery before confirming.
address.note: Editing a profile does not replace existing delivery addresses. Operators correcting a locked delivery must record a reason.

recovery.title: Recover blocked work
recovery.summary: Check the cause and review again before retrying.
recovery.steps:
If quota is insufficient, reduce dates/slots or have the operator record the correct purchase.
If production is incomplete, open the same date and slot’s production version and resolve missing meals.
If data changed, close and reopen the form after refreshing. Check the latest information before repeating the change.
recovery.note: Back retains inputs while the dialog stays open. For batch work, inspect each result: successful deliveries are not repeated when retrying the remainder.

packages.title: Manage package definitions
packages.summary: Set the delivery count and validity for new purchases.
packages.steps:
Open Packages and choose Add package, or Edit an existing package.
Enter the name, delivery count and validity; leave validity empty for a package without expiry.
Save the definition. Record a purchase on the customer account to grant quota.
packages.note: A package definition alone does not grant quota. Purchases keep the terms recorded at purchase time; later package edits do not change past purchases.

offerings.title: Publish meals for a date
offerings.summary: Offer meal choices and a main meal for a delivery date and time slot.
offerings.steps:
Open Meals, prepare the meal definitions, then choose Publish meals.
Choose the date, time slot, available meals and one main meal included in those choices.
Review and save. After the cutoff, enter a reason and inspect the new production revision.
offerings.note: A meal selected on an active delivery cannot be removed from the offering. At cutoff, empty choices use the available main meal; incomplete production blocks readiness.
